final: WITH linked AS (SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg), counts AS (SELECT ordertypedist, COUNT(DISTINCT translink) as trans_count FROM linked GROUP BY ordertypedist), with_shares AS (SELECT ordertypedist, trans_count, CAST(trans_count AS FLOAT) / SUM(trans_count) OVER () as share FROM counts), baseline_calc AS (SELECT AVG(share) as baseline_share FROM with_shares) SELECT COALESCE(ws.ordertypedist, 'No mix recorded') as order_type_mix, ws.trans_count as distinct_transactions, ws.share, ws.share - bc.baseline_share as above_baseline FROM with_shares ws CROSS JOIN baseline_calc bc WHERE ws.share > bc.baseline_share ORDER BY ws.share DESC
